# Croftweaver Guide

> A free guide for people who run a website and would rather not learn jargon: how Google and AI
> assistants find sites, and what you can do about it. Every claim about how Google or an AI
> service behaves names who published the source and links it. Served at https://guide.croftweaver.com/llms.txt.

## Pages
- [Home](https://guide.croftweaver.com/): A free guide for people who run a website and would rather not learn jargon. Every claim about Google or AI names its source, and links it.
- [How AI answers work](https://guide.croftweaver.com/how-ai-answers-work): An AI assistant answers from what it learned in training, or searches the web first. Here is where each one searches, as the companies say it.
- [SEO basics for website owners](https://guide.croftweaver.com/seo): How Google finds, stores and picks pages to show, in Google's own words. No secret tricks, and what a small business can do itself.
- [GEO: what it is, and what it isn't](https://guide.croftweaver.com/geo): GEO is a name for work aimed at being quoted in AI answers. What Google says about it, what the research found, and what we suggest.
- [E-E-A-T: show who's behind your site](https://guide.croftweaver.com/eeat): E-E-A-T is not a ranking factor, says Google; it is what its reviewers look for. For a small business it mostly means: make it clear who you are.
- [AI crawlers: who to let in](https://guide.croftweaver.com/ai-crawlers): Which AI companies read your website, what each crawler is for, in the companies' own words, and how to allow or block them.
- [llms.txt: do you need one?](https://guide.croftweaver.com/llms-txt): Google Search ignores llms.txt, and the studies we found show little effect. What it is, what the studies found, and when it is worth making.
- [Structured data and FAQs for AI](https://guide.croftweaver.com/schema-and-faq): Does special markup help AI quote you? What Google says, three studies side by side with who paid for each, and what we suggest instead.
- [How long until Google and AI find you](https://guide.croftweaver.com/how-long): How long Google and AI assistants take to find a new website: the ranges companies give, what we found no published measurement for, and our own log.
- [Why doesn't ChatGPT mention my business?](https://guide.croftweaver.com/why-ai-doesnt-mention-you): You are not alone. The usual reasons a local business is not named by AI assistants, each with its source named and linked.
- [Check your site: five tests](https://guide.croftweaver.com/check-your-site): Five tests you can run yourself with a browser: how to run each, what the result tells you, and what it doesn't.
- [AI SEO checklist: what matters](https://guide.croftweaver.com/ai-seo-checklist): A short checklist for being found on Google and named by AI assistants. Each check links to its source and its test, and we list what we left off.
- [Glossary](https://guide.croftweaver.com/glossary): The words this guide uses, in everyday language. Each entry links the page it comes from, and says when we found no definition from the company concerned.
- [About this guide](https://guide.croftweaver.com/about): Who publishes the Croftweaver Guide, who wrote it, how AI helped, how sources are checked and where we corrected ourselves.
- [What we searched](https://guide.croftweaver.com/search-records): The dated record behind every sentence in this guide that says we found no published answer: what we looked for, and what we found.
- [Privacy](https://croftweaver.com/privacy): privacy policy.
- [Imprint](https://croftweaver.com/imprint): provider identification.
